verdicts.reason: A has a clean left-to-right banner order: bottle, then brand, headline and copy, then the CTA, with comfortable spacing. Its flaws: SOLSTICE, the headline and the subline start at three different left edges, the subline is very small at this size, and the two decorative circles have shrunk into stray dots crammed against the right edge. B is badly cramped. The oversized headline nearly touches the top edge and runs into the overlapping green and yellow circles. The subline wraps into three ragged lines squeezed beside the bottle. The CTA is jammed against the right and bottom edges, and SOLSTICE floats alone at the far left, cut off from the rest of the content.
